Preserve explicit frozen audit verdict, schedule, public source pins, selected raw/capture/clock identities and limitations. Drop identity dictionaries, raw action identity fields, original catalog rows, private paths, full origin lists, owner/token values or digests and private transport values. Convert process relationships to booleans and active transports to a count. Keep catalog before-size mismatches and unobserved retirement status unchanged. Source SHA values identify unchanged original audit artifacts.

Preserve only public package/runtime/tool/hash/configuration pins and separate stored 31-host-fixture and 11-new-binding-check outcomes. Omit full config, commands, logs, source manifests, paths to private transport, owner data and diagnostics with process identities. R7 changes only the observer among original R6 files and adds its host race fixture; the controller and product binaries remain unchanged. No fixture is rerun and no new hardware result is inferred from host preparation.

Preserve explicit restoration booleans/timestamps and selected file/registration identities only. Drop raw commands, SQLite/catalog bodies, process/owner identities, token values/digests and private transport content. Retain source file SHA chains and six public Aidoku path/content hashes while omitting inode/device identity fields. Keep signal-case statuses separate in each case file; recovery reason alone is not natural-exit proof.

Compose an English overview of the stored four-case qualification only. Preserve intentional KILL/TERM statuses, raw-framebuffer comparison scope and ancestry limitations. Separate existing 31/11 host checks from actual four-case device evidence and from the actual 55 admitted commands/7814-byte maximum. Do not update startup AB statistics or claim optical, sleep/wake, input-ready or final product acceptance.

global_transformations: Emit only the fixed selected fields. Preserve null and observed false values; missing fields are omitted rather than synthesized.
Original private clock records are represented by byte length, SHA-256, mode/UID and mirror equality; original PIDs are omitted.

Process/owner/nonce/native UUID identities are never copied. Worker actions bind to worker admission; application PGID/SID equality and the source live ancestry witness are booleans with the archived intermediate-chain limitation retained.
Preserve intentional cancellation entry/worker status 143 and unobserved retirement entry status null. The generic normal-exit recovery reason is not promoted to natural or normal-UI exit proof.

Compare only the packed visible Gray8 framebuffer payloads and original metadata/header identities; publish no pixels. Do not claim equality of row padding, the entire smem allocation, offscreen buffers, optical output or sleep/wake state.

Preserve source catalog contentSize literals and parse document byte counts from stat records, including the candidate-qualify 85-versus-95 before-opening mismatch; do not bind the installed extractor size unit.

Separate stored 31-host-fixture and 11-new-binding-check results from the four-case hardware qualification and actual 55 admitted command events / observed 7814-byte maximum. No result is rerun or pooled with startup AB.
Original raw source byte identities must match the frozen independent origin manifest. Only the audit artifacts explicitly pinned in this manifest may be absent from their own origin list.
Omit full origin lists, raw commands/configs/logs, raw archives, executable bytes, account/title/query/reader state, private transport values, original owner/token/nonce identities and token digests.
The four-case stored qualification does not adopt the product or establish manual reader lifecycle, input readiness or optical completion.
